peekaboo.description: Control local macOS desktop apps with Peekaboo: inspect windows, capture screenshots, click, type, scroll and use menus. Observe the exact target with see before input and use fresh snapshot references. If an action reports dispatched_unverified, observe its effect before deciding whether to retry; never blindly repeat input. Screenshots may contain private information; target only the app needed for the user's task.

browser.description: Drive a real Chrome window with DOM-level control: open URLs, read page structure as an accessibility snapshot, click/type/hover/select, fill forms, upload files, run JS, read console and network, take screenshots. Use for logged-in web consoles (with user approval); the Chrome profile at ~/.pi/browser-profile keeps sign-ins between sessions.
